name: Passkey Account Registration
summary: A new user chooses passkey registration, provides first name, last name, email, and optional company details, completes the platform passkey ceremony, receives an automatically created home organization, and enters the application.
finalOutcome: Exactly one durable user exists; the proved passkey is bound to that user; the user owns one home organization tenant with a reserved namespace derived from Company when supplied or from First Name and Last Name otherwise; the home organization is also current; and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Happy path revised around user-visible action boundaries and automatic home-organization creation.

Scenario reconciliation confirmed the five-step new-account chain from Welcome through Continue Passkey, Registration Identity, Enrollment, Confirmation, and Home. Presentation remains open because required registration surfaces are planned or behaviorally mismatched.
